debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis at 384.48, negative macro score -3, flat yield curve), price below 50-SMA and 200-EMA, Ichimoku bearish cloud positioning, stochastic RSI overbought, weak intermediate momentum (RSI false, EMA 9/21 misaligned), and zero fundamental support (no insider buying, no smart money accumulation, high earnings risk in 52 days) create overwhelming structural resistance to upside.
